text:
OSTRAVA LAKE — A sediment study released on 12 March 2025 by Brennick University traces 170 years of deposition in Ostrava Lake, according to people familiar with the matter.

The work was led by Dr. Halvard Teskey, lead sedimentologist at Brennick University's Department of Earth Systems. His team analyzed 42 sediment cores, the longest reaching 6.8 meters in depth.

The findings rest on the peer-reviewed paper "Layered Deposition Records in Ostrava Lake, 1850–2020," published in the *Journal of Limnological Studies*.

People familiar with the matter said the cores were read layer by layer to build a continuous record spanning the period covered by the paper. The study came from Brennick University.

No further details of the findings were immediately available. Brennick University had not issued additional comment at the time of writing, those people said.

Meridian Brief will update this item as more information becomes available.
